defects: The sling remains completely absent from the three-quarter and detail production views.
incumbent_comparison: No visible improvement over v001. The second candidate still contains the frame but lacks the sling because the generator stopped at the same typed-array error.
likely_causes: The recipe added more stripes and hardware, but the generator's untyped color array still prevents the sling builder from running.
next_action_hypothesis: Correct the typed color array and add an explicit minimum generated-mesh check so the next candidate cannot silently omit its main fabric sling.

observations.art_direction_fit: The neutral colors suit the room, but the missing central textile prevents the intended color pattern from appearing.
observations.close_up_quality: The detail view again captures mostly room wall and the empty frame instead of the intended sling.
observations.gameplay_readability: The incomplete object is visible but has no hammock surface; RoomDefinition navigation and collision are unchanged.
observations.geometric_detail: Support legs, braces, sling rods, rings, and eyelet geometry are present, but the major woven surface is not.
observations.material_realism: The steel frame reads as dark metal; the requested fabric cannot be judged because no canvas mesh was generated.
observations.proportion: The frame remains consistent with the intended 118 x 40 x 34-inch proportions.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot measured 115.64 x 36.34 x 28.64 inches, within the factory's 20 percent tolerance of the target envelope.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The frame is visible, but the absent textile keeps this from reading as a complete hammock.
observations.silhouette_quality: The two supports and span remain clear; the expected sagging fabric silhouette is missing.
observations.surface_variation: The v2 stripe recipe has no visible effect while the canvas generator fails.
observations.technical_integration: The wrapper logged generator exit code zero, but the saved scene has only nine meshes and its generation log records a GDScript typed-array error.
